find:
- name: Apply portfolio.ts to the database
        # The tick seeds only an empty database and never re-reads a seed, so a line's operating loop, owner steps,
        # KPIs, criteria or target changed in src/revenue/portfolio.ts reached no report until someone ran this by hand
        # (tick 63, 7.10.2026). Before the tick, so this run's REPORT.md and dashboard.html print the texts as the code
        # has them; in this job, so the commit step's `git add -f state/colony` takes the database it wrote. It never
        # writes a line's budget (the board review's allocation) or tier, status, setup-done flag or launch date
        # (ledger.ts updateLineFromSeed), and kills only a line KILLED_LINES names that is not killed yet.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/colony.ts sync-portfolio

      - name: Run one colony tick
        env:
          # Present only once the owner adds them; each connector is skipped
          # while its key is unset, and the tick makes no network calls at all
          # when none are set.
          LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY }}
          GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY }}
          # The il-biz-tools / pcn874 page-view read (src/revenue/page-views-reader.ts): a PostHog
          # personal API key with the query-read scope only, and the project's numeric id (not a
          # secret; site.json posthog.projectId is the fallback). Without both - and without the
          # site's counter on and a D0 in state/colony/page-view-clock.json - it reads nothing and
          # the report says which part is missing. At most one query per completed week.
          POSTHOG_READ_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_READ_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # No orchestrator runs here, so filing a goal nothing can execute
          # would freeze the queue at depth one. Governance runs; execution waits.
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/colony.ts tick --no-feed ${{ inputs.force && '--force' || '' }} | tee /tmp/colony-tick.txt

        run: |

          pnpm exec tsx scripts/colony.ts tick --no-feed ${{ inputs.force && '--force' || '' }} | tee /tmp/colony-tick.txt

      - name: Apply portfolio.ts to the database
        # The tick seeds only an empty database and never re-reads a seed, so a line's operating loop, owner steps,
        # KPIs, criteria or target changed in src/revenue/portfolio.ts reached no report until someone ran this by hand
        # (tick 63, 7.10.2026). Before the tick, so this run's REPORT.md and dashboard.html print the texts as the code
        # has them; in this job, so the commit step's `git add -f state/colony` takes the database it wrote. It never
        # writes a line's budget (the board review's allocation) or tier, status, setup-done flag or launch date
